topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: When I found the hidden room, the walls were cold, the air stale. It was buried behind the bookshelf, exactly where the odd creaks seemed to come from. Inside, the dust motes danced in a shaft of light. Old things filled the space—forgotten chairs, an ancient typewriter, and books, their pages yellowed with age. I ran my fingers over them, wondering why they were hidden away, what secrets they might hold. The room was a time capsule, but to me, it felt more like a place of solace that no one bothered to visit anymore. It was as silent as my thoughts, and just as heavy.
